entry.title: Patrick Stewart, ‘Star Trek’ and ‘X-Men’ actor, dies at 86

media:group.media:title: Patrick Stewart, ‘Star Trek’ and ‘X-Men’ actor, dies at 86
media:group.media:description:
Patrick Stewart, the classically trained stage actor known for his roles in the “Star Trek” franchise and “X-Men” films, has died at age 86 following what his spokesperson called “a brief and poignant journey” with Alzheimer's disease and Lewy Body Dementia.
